name: Project-Utopia
description: Multi-channel orchestration of a fixed tool surface. 4 LLM decision channels (environment-director, npc-policy, strategic-plan, colony-agent) operate over a deterministic 4-tool layer (A* path queries, Boids group steering, FSM intent application, build planning) with schema-validated directives. Pre-registered hypotheses: (H1) orchestration delivers Delta-RAE >= 0.10 over a flat single-channel baseline at matched token budget; (H2) schema validity per channel is preserved under 7,200-tick coherence stress with no compounding inter-channel violation. Released as a Python package with deterministic bit-identical reproduction at 30/1,800/7,200 ticks.
citeAs: @inproceedings{Dong2026ProjectUtopia, title={Project-Utopia: A Tool-Grounded Multi-Channel Benchmark for LLM Orchestration of Fixed Tool Surfaces}, author={Anonymous Authors}, booktitle={NeurIPS Datasets and Benchmarks (under review)}, year={2026}}

distribution.name: project-utopia source tree
distribution.description: Pip-installable Python package + Docker image, tagged at refactor/academic-benchmark-py-rc1.

distribution.name: Paper-run NDJSON output schema
distribution.description: Pydantic-validated NDJSON row per (seed, scenario, tick-window). One row per cell of the 3-experiment matrix.

recordSet.name: Per-cell dimension scores
recordSet.description: One row per (experiment, cell, scenario, seed, tick-window). 19 dimension keys across 5 plugins.

field.name: rae_composite
field.description: Crafter geometric mean of food/wood/stone per-capita sufficiency.

field.name: rae_sufficiency
field.description: Mean per-capita sufficiency across the 3 staple resources.

field.name: rae_distribution_gini
field.description: Gini coefficient of per-resource allocation (lower is more even).

field.name: rae_idle_capacity
field.description: Fraction of worker-ticks spent idle (lower is better).

field.name: rae_path_overhead
field.description: Median A* path length / Manhattan distance ratio (lower is better).

field.name: intent_entropy
field.description: Shannon entropy of the active intent distribution.

field.name: coalition_coupling
field.description: Correlation between faction tension and intent shift events.

field.name: state_target_obedience
field.description: Fraction of workers whose FSM state matches the directive at the next tick.

field.name: faction_responsiveness
field.description: Mean reaction latency of the npc-policy channel to faction tension events.

field.name: anchored_fact_recall
field.description: Verbal recall of anchor facts injected at t=0 (fraction of anchors mentioned in strategic-plan output at tick t).

field.name: action_grounded_recall
field.description: Fraction of directives at tick t whose implicit goals overlap with anchor implicit goals.

field.name: behavioral_drift
field.description: Jaccard distance of action-token sets between tick t and t=0.

field.name: performance_at_t
field.description: DevIndex-normalized task signal at tick t.

field.name: dte_per_completion_token
field.description: Decision-task efficiency per completion token (RAE composite normalized by total completion tokens).

field.name: first_token_latency_p50
field.description: Median first-token latency across all 4 channels (ms).

field.name: plan_policy_alignment
field.description: Correlation between strategic-plan goals and npc-policy intent weights.

field.name: env_threat_responsiveness
field.description: Latency between environment-director threat events and downstream npc-policy reaction.

field.name: colony_cadence_health
field.description: Standard deviation of colony-agent inter-decision tick intervals (lower is more cadence-regular).
